title: PATCH and DELETE Resources
summary: Update only supplied fields with PATCH and remove resources intentionally with DELETE while handling missing ids.

sketchBlocks.cardTitle: Change only what the client supplied
sketchBlocks.title: PATCH performs a partial update

tryItExercises.title: Patch a room resource
tryItExercises.prompt: Implement `PATCH /api/rooms/:id`. Return `404` JSON if absent. Update only supplied `name` and `capacity`, then return the updated room with status `200`.
tryItExercises.hint: Check each allowed field independently so omitted values remain unchanged.

help.concept: PATCH applies only supplied allowed fields while preserving the rest of the resource.
help.hint_1: Find the room before changing it.
help.hint_2: Use an explicit undefined check for each field.

sketchBlocks.title: DELETE finds the target before mutating

tryItExercises.title: Delete an announcement
tryItExercises.prompt: Implement `DELETE /api/announcements/:id`. Find the index, return `404` JSON if absent, otherwise remove exactly one item and return status `204` with no body.
tryItExercises.hint: Use the index lookup to distinguish a valid position from the missing sentinel.

help.concept: DELETE should locate exactly one target before mutating the collection.
help.hint_1: Convert the route id before comparing numeric ids.
help.hint_2: Remove one item only after handling the missing branch.

quizDraft.title: Recognize a partial update
quizDraft.prompt: Which description matches PATCH in this module?
quizDraft.hint: Choose the behavior that preserves omitted fields.

help.concept: A partial update changes selected allowed properties without replacing the whole resource.
help.hint_1: Imagine the client sends only one field.

options: Update only allowed fields that were supplied.
Replace every field whether supplied or not.
Create a new collection on every request.
Use the method only for reads.

quizDraft.title: Protect mutation targets
quizDraft.prompt: Which two checks help PATCH and DELETE avoid mutating the wrong resource?
quizDraft.hint: Focus on identity and the missing-target branch.

help.concept: Mutation routes need a trustworthy lookup and a clear not-found outcome before state changes.
help.hint_1: One correct choice normalizes the incoming id.
help.hint_2: Another stops when no target exists.

options: Convert the route id to the data's id type.
Handle the missing target before mutating.
Ignore the route id and mutate the first item.
Treat every missing id as successful.

quizDraft.title: Complete the delete outcome
quizDraft.prompt: Choose the successful no-content status used by the delete example.
quizDraft.hint: Choose the success option whose semantics allow an intentionally empty body.

help.concept: A deletion can succeed without returning a resource representation.
help.hint_1: The answer is not a client-error outcome.
help.hint_2: Look for the no-body success choice.

quizDraft.template: After removing the resource and sending no response body, the route returns HTTP status [blank1].

quizDraft.title: Order a safe delete
quizDraft.prompt: Arrange the delete route from identity to response.
quizDraft.hint: Do not mutate the collection before the route knows whether a target exists.

help.concept: A safe delete performs identity lookup before mutation.
help.hint_2: The removal happens after the missing branch.
